# Backend API Reference
# Auto-generated by scanning FastAPI backend (paythan / gamer-circle)
# Base URL: http://localhost:8000/api/v1
# OpenAPI: http://localhost:8000/openapi.json
# Health: http://localhost:8000/health
# Scanned: 29 Jun 2026

> **Note:** The main backend lives at `../backend/`. Admin endpoints are Phase 3 stubs (2 routes only).
> A separate admin microservice scaffold exists in `backend/` (this repo) but its routers are not fully implemented.

---

## AUTH
| Method | Path | Auth | Body | Response | Description |
|--------|------|------|------|----------|-------------|
| POST | /auth/signup/request-otp | Public | `{name, username, email, phone_number}` | `MessageResponse` | Send WhatsApp OTP for signup |
| POST | /auth/signup/verify-otp | Public | `{phone_number, otp, password}` | `TokenResponse` | Verify OTP, set password, create account |
| POST | /auth/login/request-otp | Public | `{phone_number}` | `MessageResponse` | Send WhatsApp OTP for login |
| POST | /auth/login/verify-otp | Public | `{phone_number, otp}` | `TokenResponse` | Verify login OTP, receive JWT |
| POST | /auth/login | Public | `{username, password}` | `TokenResponse` | Login with username + password |
| POST | /auth/refresh-token | Public | `{refresh_token}` | `TokenResponse` | Rotate refresh token |
| GET | /auth/me | Bearer | - | `UserResponse` | Current authenticated user |
| POST | /auth/logout | Bearer | `{refresh_token}` | `MessageResponse` | Revoke refresh token |

**TokenResponse:** `{access_token, refresh_token, token_type, expires_in, user: UserResponse}`

## USERS
| Method | Path | Auth | Body | Response | Description |
|--------|------|------|------|----------|-------------|
| GET | /users/me | Bearer | - | `UserResponse` | Current user profile |
| PATCH | /users/me | Bearer | `UserUpdate` | `UserResponse` | Update profile (name, username, email, phone) |
| PATCH | /users/me/location | Bearer | `UserLocationUpdate` | `UserResponse` | Update GPS location |
| GET | /users/me/following | Bearer | - | `ParlorSummary[]` | Parlors the user follows |
| GET | /users/me/bookings | Bearer | `?upcoming` | `BookingResponse[]` | User's tournament bookings |
| GET | /users/me/blocks | Bearer | - | `UserSummary[]` | Blocked users list |
| GET | /users/{user_id} | Bearer | - | `UserResponse` | Get user by ID |
| GET | /users/{user_id}/mutual-friends | Bearer | - | `MutualFriendsResponse` | Mutual friends with user |
| POST | /users/{user_id}/block | Bearer | - | 204 | Block a user |
| DELETE | /users/{user_id}/block | Bearer | - | 204 | Unblock a user |
| GET | /users/search | Bearer | `?q` | `UserSummary[]` | Search users by query |
| GET | /users/me/qr-code | Bearer | - | `{qr_data, username}` | Profile QR code data |
| PUT | /users/me/profile | Bearer | `ProfileUpdate` | `{user_id, updated}` | Update extended profile |
| GET | /users/{user_id}/profile | Optional | - | `PublicProfileResponse` | Public profile view |
| GET | /users/{user_id}/status | Public | - | `OnlineStatusResponse` | User online status |
| PUT | /users/me/status-privacy | Bearer | `StatusPrivacyUpdate` | 204 | Update status privacy |
| POST | /users/me/heartbeat | Bearer | - | 204 | Heartbeat for online presence |

## DATA MODELS (from Pydantic schemas)

### User
```typescript
{
  id: UUID,
  name: string | null,           // ORM: full_name
  username: string | null,
  email: string | null,
  phone_number: string | null,   // ORM: phone
  role: 'user' | 'parlor_owner' | 'admin',
  avatar_url: string | null,
  is_active: boolean,
  is_verified: boolean,
  email_verified: boolean,
  phone_verified: boolean,
  latitude: number | null,
  longitude: number | null,
  city: string | null,
  country: string | null,        // ISO 3166-1 alpha-2
  location_updated_at: datetime | null,
  created_at: datetime,
  updated_at: datetime
}
```

### Parlor
```typescript
{
  id: UUID,
  owner_id: UUID | null,
  name: string,
  description: string | null,
  logo_url: string | null,
  address: string | null,
  latitude: number | null,
  longitude: number | null,
  game_types: string[],
  is_verified: boolean,
  follower_count: number,
  post_count: number,
  is_following: boolean,
  rating: number | null,
  phone: string | null,
  website: string | null,
  created_at: datetime,
  updated_at: datetime
}
```

### Post
```typescript
{
  id: UUID,
  content: string,
  media_urls: string[],          // NO media_type field — infer from URL extension
  parlor: ParlorSummary,
  tournament: { id, title } | null,
  likes_count: number,
  comments_count: number,
  is_liked: boolean,
  created_at: datetime
}
```
> **No `media_type`, `geo_lat`, or `geo_lng` on Post.** Geo is on User/Parlor models. Reels are a separate entity.

### Reel
```typescript
{
  id: UUID,
  user: ReelUserSummary,
  video_url: string,
  thumbnail_url: string | null,
  cover_url: string | null,
  caption: string | null,
  hashtags: string[],
  location: string | null,     // text location, NOT lat/lng
  duration_seconds: number | null,
  privacy: 'public' | 'friends' | 'private' | ...,
  likes_count: number,
  comments_count: number,
  views_count: number,
  shares_count: number,
  bookmarks_count: number,
  is_liked: boolean,
  is_bookmarked: boolean,
  created_at: datetime
}
```

### Tournament
```typescript
{
  id: UUID,
  parlor_id: UUID,
  parlor: ParlorSummary,
  title: string,
  game_type: string,
  format: string,
  start_time: datetime,
  end_time: datetime,
  total_slots: number,
  booked_slots: number,
  entry_fee: decimal,
  prizes: Record<string, string> | null,
  rules: string | null,
  status: 'draft' | 'open' | 'full' | 'live' | 'completed' | 'cancelled',
  is_booked_by_me: boolean,
  created_at: datetime,
  updated_at: datetime
}
```

### Booking

```typescript
{
  id: UUID,
  tournament_id: UUID,
  user_id: UUID,
  slot_number: number,
  status: string,

}
```

### Comment
```typescript
{
  id: UUID,
  user: { id, name, avatar_url },
  content: string,
  parent_id: UUID | null,
  likes_count: number,
  is_liked: boolean,
```

### Like

```typescript
{ target_type: 'post' | 'comment', target_id: UUID }
// LikeToggleResponse
{ liked: boolean, likes_count: number }
```

```typescript
  id: UUID,

}
```

```typescript
{
```

## ROLE VALUES
| Role | Value | Notes |
|------|-------|-------|
| User | `user` | Default role |
| Parlor Owner | `parlor_owner` | Can create/manage parlors & tournaments |
| Admin | `admin` | Required for `/admin/*` endpoints (403 otherwise) |

> **`super_admin` does not exist** in the current backend `UserRole` enum. Angular admin docs reference it for future RBAC.
